limitation: target is a 3-level single-grader label; published inter-expert kappa on this task is 0.29-0.71, so part of the error is the label and cannot be separated out with one grader
cut_note: cut_plus / cut_preplus are the operating points. They were printed by fit_plus_index.py but never saved, so a service could not turn a score into a grade. Recomputed 2026-09-02 with the same features, weights and patient-split out-of-fold procedure on the same 633 eye-visits / 255 patients. Note the low PPV: at cut_plus the score flags 177 eyes to catch 33. That is the screening trade deliberately chosen - missing plus disease is far worse than a second look.
